remarks:
Welcome to the heart of Bemus Point, where lake life and village charm come together! This beautifully updated four-bedroom, one-bath home offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy everything this sought-after Chautauqua Lake community has to offer.



Ideally located just one block from Chautauqua Lake, this property is within walking distance of Bemus Point’s vibrant shops, restaurants, waterfront attractions, and year-round community events. Whether you’re seeking a personal getaway, a full-time residence, or an investment opportunity, the property’s ability to be used as a short-term rental adds tremendous flexibility and value.



Inside, you’ll find a thoughtfully updated interior featuring comfortable living spaces, modern finishes, and room for family and guests alike. The four-bedroom layout provides plenty of space to relax after a day on the lake or exploring the village.



Enjoy summer evenings strolling to local dining, live music, and lakefront activities, all just steps from your front door. Opportunities like this are rare in one of Chautauqua Lake’s most desirable destinations. Experience the best of Bemus Point living with this move-in-ready home that perfectly blends convenience, charm, and investment potential.
